row.notes: Stores mode at +0x70; if HDR is allowed for the active output (+0x31b1[+0x134-1]) picks backbuffer format byte +0x6c (0x0e SDR, 0x4d for modes 1/3, 0x23 for mode 2) and checks/sets swapchain (+0xa50) colour space via vtbl +0x128/+0x130 (0, 0xc, 1). On Nvidia (+0x880==0x10de) queries display HDR caps through NVAPI thunks (log channel MULTI-GPU, 'NVAPI Error: %s') and sets +0x31b0. Propagates the format to +0xa30 and backbuffer object +0x1d40, optionally pushes display chromaticities (+0x6d8..+0x710) to 0x145381b30, sets dirty flag +0xb40. Good hook for forcing HDR/SDR.
